svg.aria-label: Axle request route: plain-English query through React on CloudFront, API Gateway and FastAPI on Lambda to a multi-tier cache; a cache hit goes straight to ranked listings; a miss goes through schema sanitization, a 40-entry alias map with fuzzy matching and two-tier model routing (cheap model for routine parses, capable model when ambiguous), then 10-level constraint relaxation and scoring to ranked listings, which return to the React client.
svg.text: results return to the React client
